extras: Attachments use mdasset:// references and require Pictether for display; reset operation deletes managed local attachments.
intentEvidence: Keep your vault clean. Keep your attachments organized.
motivation: To keep the vault clean and attachments organized without complicated setup.
problem: Bulky media files clutter the vault and make organization difficult within Obsidian.
summary: Pictether is a local-first attachment manager that keeps media files outside the vault and provides optional S3-compatible backup and recovery.
